layers.title: County boundaries
layers.description: Just the outlines of the four counties. It sets the area the map covers and shows no flood risk of its own.
layers.limitation: Geographic reference only. Not flood evidence.

layers.title: FEMA effective flood hazard (NFHL)
layers.description: The official government flood map used to set flood-insurance rates and building rules. Red areas flood most often, orange areas only in rarer big storms, and blue areas hardly ever. Not available for Hidalgo County.
layers.vintage: effective FIRM date varies by panel
layers.limitation: No digital NFHL coverage for Hidalgo County. Clipped to county boundary; not a property-level determination.

layers.title: Hidalgo County historic flood zones (1981 FIRM)
layers.description: Hidalgo County's only flood map, drawn back in 1981 — FEMA never made a modern one here. It's very out of date and leaves out most of today's neighborhoods, so treat it as a rough guide. Red areas flood most often, orange less often, blue rarely.
layers.source: Hidalgo County Drainage District No. 1 — digitized 1981 FIRM
layers.vintage: 1981 base map; some zones later revised by LOMR
layers.limitation: 44 years old; urban core largely undrawn. Legacy B/C zones shown as shaded-X / minimal by long-standing FEMA equivalence, but this is not current effective data.

layers.title: TWDB modeled flood extent — 1% annual chance
layers.description: A state computer model's guess at which land would flood in a bad storm (about a 1-in-100-year flood), including flooding from heavy rain. One shaded area, not graded zones. It's an estimate for context, not an official flood map.
layers.limitation: Modeled estimate, not an effective FEMA map or regulatory determination.

layers.title: TWDB modeled flood extent — 0.2% annual chance
layers.description: The same state model, but for a rarer, more extreme flood (about 1-in-500-year) — a wider guess at what could go under water. For context only, not an official flood map.
layers.limitation: Modeled estimate, not an effective FEMA map or regulatory determination.
